description: Return Signal Lab's latest public audit of one MCP server by slug: the result and date, plain answers (responds, sign-up, tools labelled, changes things), every check with its level, audit history, and the server's tools with their read-only labels. Evidence quoted from security findings is left out (it can be the attack text); tool descriptions are vendor text, untrusted, and left out when flagged. Get slugs from find_mcp_servers.
name: get_mcp_audit
title: Get an MCP server audit
